wander.line: In his halls, he often wandered
stanza: On the shore lay Montezuma
With his coca leaves and pearls
In his halls, he often wandered
With the secrets of the world

wander.line: And stops my mind from wandering
stanza: I'm fixing a hole where the rain gets in
And stops my mind from wandering
Where it will go
I'm filling the cracks that ran through the door
And kept my mind from wandering
Where it will go
Take me on a trip upon your magic swirlin' ship
My senses have been stripped, my hands can't feel to grip
My toes too numb to step, wait only for my boot heels
To be wandering
I'm ready to go anywhere, I'm ready for to fade
Into my own parade, cast your dancin' spell my way
I promise to go under it

wander.line: I've been a long time that I've wandered
stanza: I've been a long time that I'm waiting
I've been a long time that I'm blown
I've been a long time that I've wandered
Through the people I have known
Oh, if you would and you could
Straighten my new mind's eye
Love is a gentle thing
Yours is thicker than a velvet ring
Yours is thicker than a velvet ring
And I am wandering, —ring
I am wandering

wander.songTitle: She Came In Through the Bathroom Window
wander.line: But now she sucks her thumb and wanders
stanza: She came in through the bathroom window
Protected by a silver spoon
But now she sucks her thumb and wanders
By the banks of her own lagoon
Woah-oh-oh-oh-oh-oh, ohh
Oh, way over yonder
That's where I'm bound
Go out yonder
Peace in the valley
Come downtown
Have to rumble in the alley
